params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to display by default in the Formula editor

params.name: formula
params.description: in: variable containing the formula to display, or "" to display the editor with no formula; out: the formula validated by the user (left untouched if the user cancels)

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the interactive Formula editor dialog, seeded with aTable's fields and an initial formula, and returns the user-edited formula text.

constraints: By default, method/command access is restricted to the Designer and Administrator; if formula calls a method not authorized via SET ALLOWED METHODS, a syntax error is generated and the dialog cannot be validated.
The formula editor has no default menu bar; install a standard Edit menu in the calling process to enable cut/copy/paste shortcuts.
The virtual structure defined by SET TABLE TITLES/SET FIELD TITLES is only used inside the Formula editor dialog; it must not be used in the formula variable outside the dialog.
Validating the dialog only stores the edited formula text into the formula variable; it does not execute it -- use EXECUTE FORMULA to run it.
